summary: Iteration 2 — validated the 4 new features (promos, points history, estimated ready, laundry photos via Emergent Object Storage) plus regression on iteration 1 flows. Backend: 40/40 pytest cases pass (27 regression + 13 new). New file /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py covers: promos public + shape (>=3 seeded), points/history auth+shape + BOTH earn & redeem txns appended atomically on /pay (balance = before - 25 + earned), estimated_ready_at is ISO on create & persisted on GET, /upload requires auth, /files/{path} 401 without token / 200 with ?token= AND with Authorization header, customer forbidden (403) on /orders/{id}/photos, admin can add photos (photos appended, customer sees them, 404 on unknown order). Frontend (mobile 390x844): customer login → home shows 3 promo banners (testID promo-*), points card tap navigates to /points-history with balance (53 poin) + earn/redeem rows rendered; profile-points-pill also navigates; tracking screen for unpaid order shows estimate-ready ('Estimasi selesai 28 Sep 2026, 01.19'), pay-button visible, no photo-camera/gallery for customer; after admin adds photo via API, admin sees photo-camera + photo-gallery buttons and laundry-photo thumb, and customer sees the same laundry-photo thumb after refetch. Also fixed one iteration-1 test flake by bumping demo customer points reset from 30 → 100 in conftest so the new redeem-on-pay test isn't skipped when running the full suite in parallel.

minor.issue: estimated_ready_at returned tz-aware on create but tz-naive on subsequent GET (Mongo persists datetime without tzinfo). Frontend JS Date parses both fine, so no functional impact — same pattern already patched for siap_at. Consider normalizing all datetime reads through a helper that re-attaches UTC (like courier endpoint does for siap_at).

react_native_issues.issue: Recurring console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking (RN 0.79+). Reference: usages inside makeStyles across screens.
Recurring console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely emitted by react-native-maps web shim or gesture-handler. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: normalize datetime read-path so estimated_ready_at (and any future datetime field) is tz-aware in every response (reuse the pattern applied to siap_at).
Optional: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /orders POST and /orders/{id}/pay atomically insert two point_txns rows and update user.points via $inc — solid pattern; no race window in single-request path.
server.py: /upload correctly caps 8MB, restricts extensions, isolates storage path by user id (loundry-suci/uploads/{user_id}/{uuid}.{ext}).
server.py: /files/{path} accepts token via BOTH Authorization header and ?token= query, letting <Image src=..> work without custom fetch — good.
server.py: /orders/{id}/photos correctly guarded by require_admin (customer path returns 403 verified in test).
Frontend order/[id].tsx: renders estimate-ready only when order.status !== 'selesai' AND estimated_ready_at present — matches spec.
Frontend points-history.tsx: 93 lines, well-scoped; uses useFocusEffect + refetch to keep balance in sync after navigating back from pay flow.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (new — 13 tests covering promos, points/history, estimated_ready, photos+object storage)
/app/backend/tests/conftest.py (bumped demo customer reset points 30 → 100 so parallel redemption tests don't skip)
seed_data_creation: conftest resets demo customer (081211112222) points to 100 at session start. Tests create ephemeral orders + photos in Emergent Object Storage under loundry-suci/uploads/{user_id}/... (not cleaned up; scoped by user id, safe).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (uses xdist 2 workers by default per pytest.ini; deterministic thanks to session-level points reset). Frontend: on web preview, expo-image-picker cannot actually open camera/gallery in headless browser — this is expected per problem statement; verify admin photo endpoint + button rendering via API/testID query (already done here). For end-to-end photo flow in UI, use the /api/upload + /api/orders/{id}/photos API path (as done in test_new_features.py::TestPhotos and in the playwright flow_3).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs introduced this iteration. Only a minor test-suite improvement (points reset value increased) to keep the new redemption test deterministic under parallel execution.
